Ava: Big shoutout to @matt_ops and @sarah.p — they saved Friday's demo (hotfix + last-minute rollback) AND watered the office ficus 🍕🌱 :tada:
matt_ops: haha team effort. I brought pizza, Sarah brought the plant mister. Demo stayed alive :relieved:
sarah.p: I only watered the ficus for moral support. Also patched the config path — weird trailing slash bug. :sweat_smile:
Lina: Legend status unlocked. Who ordered pizza? I owe you coffee. :coffee: @Ava you intro or we did it stealthy?
Ava: I ordered from Frankie’s (code: FRANKIE20). Left a sticky note on @matt_ops desk: "Ops hero — one slice reserved" 😄
DevBot: deploy@prod finished in 12s (canary -> stable) — checked by @matt_ops :white_check_mark:
CJ: can we get a Ficus MVP sticker for the plant? 
Lina: +1 for sticker. Also, tiny poll: pizza next Friday? react with :pizza: for yes, :shrug: for maybe, :no_entry_sign: for no.
sarah.p: voted :pizza: (and I will bring extra napkins)
matt_ops: :pizza:
Ava: :pizza: — thanks again everyone. small wins all around :sparkles:
CJ: also, quick note — thanks to whoever closed GH issue #428: the demo graphs load way faster now.
sarah.p: that was me earlier this morning when I found the missing index. low-key satisfying.
Lina: applause emoji chain in #random! :clap::clap::clap:
